description: Eligibility belongs to a whole witness. Two witnesses of r reach the omission of [T] after y. In the first, [A] is empty and y → A B, but the same prefix reads A B C as y and then the written T, so the omission is forbidden. In the second, [A] reads A and y → B z [U], so the omission of [T] is permitted, but its omission of [U] is forbidden, since z can read C T before the written U. So begins of r is false (engine §4).
grammar:
%elidable T U
%rule text A B C T U
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r [A] y [T] C T U
%rule y A B | A B C | B z [U]
%rule z ε | C T
